results.content: # 25 Best ETL Tools Real-Time Sync vs Batch. Compare 25 batch and real-time data integration tools for 2026. See which ETL platforms handle streaming, batch, and bi-directional sync for enterprise pipelines. Batch and real-time data integration tools serve different purposes. Batch ETL processes data on a schedule, which works for warehouse loads and reporting. Real-time ETL tools move data the moment it changes, which matters when CRM, ERP, and database systems need to stay in sync. * Batch ETL suits analytics and warehousing, while real-time tools are essential for operational systems needing instant data consistency. * Most enterprises use hybrid architectures combining batch pipelines for analytics and real-time sync for operational workflows. * Most ETL tools focus on one-way data movement, making them unsuitable for bi-directional operational synchronization. Enterprise teams now run mixed workloads: batch ETL for analytics and data warehousing, real-time ELT tools for operational consistency, and dedicated sync platforms for bi-directional CRM/ERP/database alignment.

results.title: Modern Data Engineering with Databricks: Evolving from ETL to ELT at Scale
results.content: # Why Modern Data Engineering Needs Databricks: From ETL to ELT at Scale. Traditional ETL pipelines, once the backbone of enterprise data processing, are now struggling to keep up with the scale, speed, and complexity of modern data demands. Unlike ETL, which transforms data before loading it into storage, ELT loads raw data first and transforms it within scalable compute environments. This is where modern data engineering with Databricks offers a transformative solution. #### Where Databricks Redefines Modern Data Engineering. Where Databricks Redefines Modern Data Engineering. Databricks is not just another data platform, it’s a unified environment that brings together storage, compute, and intelligence under one roof. With Databricks, organizations can manage structured and unstructured data, run batches and streaming workloads, and build machine learning models, all within a single platform. Traditional ETL pipelines are rigid, slow, and ill-suited for real-time data processing. By loading raw data first, teams can transform it on-demand using powerful compute engines. Databricks unifies data access, enabling cross-functional collaboration and shared intelligence. #### Real-Time Data Processing at Enterprise Scale. Databricks supports streaming-first architecture through Structured Streaming, enabling enterprises to process data as it arrives. Whether it’s handling late-arriving events, out-of-order data, or high-volume streams, Databricks delivers the performance and reliability needed for sub-second decisioning. From fraud detection to personalized recommendations, real-time data processing is a competitive advantage, and Databricks makes it scalable. To build scalable ELT pipelines on Databricks, organizations should follow a few key principles:. Modern data engineering with Databricks enables faster, smarter, and more scalable data workflows. Databricks’ lakehouse architecture unifies data management, analytics, and AI, eliminating silos and boosting collaboration. Declarative pipelines, real-time processing, and built-in governance make Databricks a future-proof platform for enterprise data strategies. #### Modernize your data stack with Databricks lakehouse architecture! #### FAQs. Databricks support modular, declarative pipelines, real-time streaming, and unified data management, making it ideal for building scalable and resilient ELT workflows. Yes, Databricks supports both batch and streaming workloads, allowing enterprises to process real-time data while maintaining compatibility with legacy batch pipelines.
